docs.text: Getting Started Welcome! This guide will walk you through the steps to get your project set up with MkDocs and publish it to Confluence. Prerequisites Before you begin, ensure you have: Python 3.8 or higher Git installed An Atlassian Confluence account An API token from your Atlassian account A Confluence space and page to publish under Project Setup Clone the Repository Clone the custom MkDocs + Confluence plugin repository: bash git clone https://github.com/denizzsarierr/mkdocs-with-confluence.git cd mkdocs-with-confluence

docs.text: Usage Guide This guide explains how to use MkDocs with the custom Confluence plugin to write, preview, and publish your documentation. Writing Documentation All documentation is written in Markdown ( .md ) files located in the docs/ folder. Example: # Introduction Welcome to the documentation site! ## Features - Easy publishing to Confluence - Markdown-based documentation - Simple configuration
